description: This is a CMake script defining a function `compile_aidl` used to generate source code from AIDL files during build time, with detailed documentation embedded as comments and reStructuredText (RST) documentation blocks.

methods.name: compile_aidl
methods.description: Defines a CMake function to compile AIDL files into source code, handling parameters such as source files, aidl binary path, flags, language, include directories, and target output directory. Executes the aidl compiler with appropriate arguments and manages success or failure messages.
